notes.title: Started developing my next title, looking for playtesters
notes.notes:
I have started to work on a new game idea. it's not a typing game, but it is based on a book. The idea is that you guess the letters in each sentence, similar to Hangman, to uncover the book. 

I am currently looking for playtesters, if you are intrested you can sign up here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283120/Jane_Austen_Simulator_Pride_and_Prejudice/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283120/Jane_Austen_Simulator_Pride_and_Prejudice/[/url]

notes.title: Update-124
notes.notes: You can now press space to get to a new line, not only enter. Pressing enter still gives you a "ding" sound.

notes.title: update - 117
notes.notes: fixed a bug that reduced performance. Should work a bit better on older computers now

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Upgraded the way writing speed is displayed, removed the accuracy score. 
fixed scrolling bug in fullscreen mode on some monitors 
improved preformance while scrolling, it's now 15 times faster.

notes.title: Layout editor
notes.notes:
I ressived some feedback that the automatic key detection wasn't working properly for everyone. I have therefore switched a system where keyboard layouts is set up manual. I have implemented a new layout editor to make this easier. 

Shift key and capslock key bugs should be gone.
